BrochureContent.Content:
New to market with Tony Donnelly of Leonard Wilson Keenan 
29 Oaktree Road is a premium mid-terrace family home boasting an exceptional A2 energy rating, enhanced by a spectacular attic conversion and a professionally landscaped rear garden.

Interior Accommodation
Designed for modern family living, the bright and spacious layout includes:
•	Ground Floor: An inviting entrance hallway, a cozy front-facing living room, a convenient guest W.C., and a separate utility room. The heart of the home features a large contemporary open-plan kitchen and dining area equipped with quality shaker-style cabinetry, integrated appliances, and elegant French doors that open out to the rear garden.
•	First Floor: Three spacious bedrooms featuring premium fitted wardrobes. The master bedroom includes a private en-suite shower room, complementing a fully tiled family bathroom and a shelved hot press for extra storage.
•	Second Floor (Attic Conversion): A fantastic, light-filled attic conversion providing versatile extra space. Complete with Velux windows, smart eave storage, and high ceilings, this room is ideal for a home office, playroom, gym, or guest accommodation.
Exterior Features
•	Front: A durable cobble locked driveway provides secure off-street parking for two cars.
•	Rear: A spectacular, professionally landscaped rear garden designed for low maintenance and maximum enjoyment. This private outdoor oasis features premium paving, stylized planting, structural bedding, and an ideal layout for outdoor entertaining and alfresco dining.
Location & Amenities
Situated in a prime residential pocket of Kildare Town, this property offers unparalleled convenience with all major amenities within walking distance:
•	Shopping & Leisure: A short walk to the world-class Kildare Village outlet shopping, local cafes, traditional pubs, and supermarkets.
•	Local Attractions: Positioned right on Tully Road, the property is a stone's throw from the world-famous Irish National Stud & Gardens and the historic Curragh Plains.
•	Education: Excellent access to localized schools, including St. Brigid’s Primary School, Kildare Town Educate Together, Gaelscoil Mhic Aodha, and Kildare Town Community School (KTCS).
•	Transport: A commuter’s dream, located less than a 5-minute drive to Junction 13 of the M7 motorway (providing swift access to Dublin, Cork, and Limerick) and walking distance to the Kildare Train Station.
